title_en: The investigation team of the 43rd Division arrested suspects in a shooting incident at Or Sor volunteer Thung Yang Daeng, Sadea border post.
summary_en: The investigation team of the 43rd Division arrested suspects in a shooting incident at Or Sor volunteer Thung Yang Daeng, Sadea border post. They were taken to interrogation centre and are being prosecuted for their involvement in the security of southern border on June 6th.
